decision_rule_reachability.reason: All six precedence branches are arithmetically reachable and no later rule is shadowed. SUPPORTS requires one COMPLETE treatment cell with task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6 (k>=3/5); reachable because the frozen scorer registers the full click-then-answer completion (carried PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5), the GBNF admits the success path, and PC-OBSERVATION-CONTRAST asserts page_text contains TARGET-42 post-reveal. FALSIFIES requires at least one COMPLETE treatment cell reproducing the parent failure signature (answer_action_emission_rate==0.0, task_success_rate==0.0); reachable because the same classes already realized this under the frozen observation. MIXED is reachable via PARTIAL_SIGNAL (answer_action_emission_rate>0 or task_success_rate>base) or a BASE cell that CLEARS (reproduction anomaly). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via preflight failure, no COMPLETE base cell, or no COMPLETE treatment cell. Thresholds (5 episodes, k in 0..5) are attainable at both ends; early-stop at rule 4 cannot shadow FALSIFIES because a non-clearing run continues and a clearing run has nothing left to falsify. Operational failures (identity/load/PC/a11y-unavailable) are explicitly non-terminal and cannot empty the FALSIFIES/MIXED branches.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The comparator is an in-run BASE cell on the SAME model bytes under the SAME runner/fixture/prompt/grammar/sampling/seeds/scorer, with the observation mode as the only varied factor. The frozen runner patch is bound by (frozen runner sha256 + patch fragment sha256 + reconstructed runner sha256) and verified before any episode. The parent's carried result (0/5 both classes) defines the expected reproduction signature, and REPRO_OK (answer_action_emission_rate==0.0 AND task_success_rate==0.0 AND step0_reveal_click_rate==1.0) is required before a treatment cell may be attributed. A BASE cell that CLEARS forces OUTCOME=MIXED with B3=UNRESOLVED rather than being silently read as a treatment success. Baseline identifiability does not rest on any stated model prior.

control_sensitivity.reason: PC-OBSERVATION-CONTRAST is a direct manipulation check on the real served page and is sensitive to the exact defect: OBS-BASE post-reveal ELEMENTS must still list #reveal-btn (defect present), OBS-VISIBLE pre-reveal must contain #reveal-btn, OBS-VISIBLE post-reveal must NOT contain it, OBS-A11Y post-reveal exposes no clickable control named 'Reveal', and page_text must contain TARGET-42 post-reveal in every mode. A DESIGN-time semantic probe of the exact two JS element sources on a synthetic element with display:none and zero rect confirmed the filter drops the hidden button post-reveal while keeping it pre-reveal (probe B5); the same assertions are re-run on the real page at EXECUTE and a failure is MEASUREMENT_INVALID. NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION (0.0/0.0) and B-RANDOM-ACTION (parseable 1.0, success<0.6) are equally sensitive to a broken scorer, as the parent measured. PC-ORACLE-EPISODE (5/5 scripted) and PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING (10/10 per cell) gate every cell before episodes. All control failures are MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a capability result.
